items.title: NIH Grants Policy Statement
items.description: The full text of the NIH Grants Policy Statement (FY 2026 revision, current with Guide Notices through March 17, 2026), one source per chapter: glossary, application and review, terms and conditions, cost considerations, prior approvals, fellowships, career awards, consortium and foreign awards. Page labels such as (GPS page IIA-76) match the official PDF.
